verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions are versioned, tenant-specific Node.js functions that customize login and identity flows; they replace the older Rules and Hooks and support reusable shared code. Built-in automatic responses can notify or block users after breached credentials and block IPs after repeated failed logins. For the AI-native angle, the official MCP server can deploy Actions. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported trigger events beyond login and identity flows, documentation of general event or webhook triggers outside identity flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
